title: Chess Mate in One
instructions: Find the single White move that delivers immediate checkmate. Touch or drag the White piece to the winning square before time runs out.
description: Chess Mate in One is a tactical chess puzzle game featuring handcrafted checkmate puzzles for players of all skill levels. Train your tactical vision, recognize classic mating nets like Anastasia, Arabian, Smothered, and Back-Rank mates, and master instant checkmate calculations with responsive tactile controls.

faqs.q: How do I play Chess Mate in One?
faqs.a: Tap or drag any White piece. Dots appear on legal squares. Find the only move that puts Black in checkmate in exactly one move.

faqs.q: What happens if I make a move that isn't checkmate?
faqs.a: The game gently notifies you that Black has an escape square or block, and automatically resets the board so you can try again.

faqs.q: How does the Hint system work?
faqs.a: Tap the Hint button to watch a short sponsored video reward and unlock the piece and target square.
